interpretation: PR2853 has 34,727 pairs in exhaustive S and 11,067 legal positive exchanges; PR2917 has 69,847 S pairs and 14,101 legal positives. These positives are historical alternatives, not newly admitted improvements above current sources.

PR2979 has S=0. Under the registered fixed-word, fixed-inventory, two-role cross-call exchange model, every possible strict positive would lie in S; thus this family has no positive exchange on that exact historical fill. This does not rule out multi-role cycles, different packing patterns, changed words, or later fills.

Legal tie/harm and illegal-predicate counts combine S with a uniform sample of its complement. They must not be presented as exhaustive counts for all 36,862,620,480 pairs. In particular sampled zero legal harms on PR2979 is not a global harm impossibility statement.
All source/seed class partitions sum to the union row count, and |S union U|=|S|+|U|-|S intersection U| holds. The two execution seeds have identical shard semantic hashes and counts.
